analysis.original_request: 我负责星载量子密钥分发接收机前端防护窗口的研发。接收机需要尽可能完整地接收 1530–1565 nm 电信波段的单光子信号，同时尽可能反射 400–700 nm 波段的可见光太阳背景，以降低空间太阳散射和探测器杂散光对量子信号接收的影响。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底的条件下，仅使用 HfO2 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar multilayer dielectric film for a spaceborne quantum key distribution receiver protective window. Incident medium: unspecified material. Substrate: Fused Silica. Materials: HfO2 and SiO2 only. Total layers <= 30. Objectives: Maximize transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band for signal reception. Maximize reflectance in 400-700 nm band to suppress solar background.
